verdict.rationale: PayPal is a payments platform/API, not an AI agent or assistant surface into which a user would plug external MCP servers for it to consume tools. All evidence shows PayPal in the opposite role — shipping its own MCP server and Agent Toolkit for other agents to call PayPal's tools — which is a different axis (PayPal as MCP server/tool-provider), not PayPal acting as an MCP client consuming third-party tools.
